title: Verbs: words for doing and being
examples: Does every sentence need a verb?

explain.say: Stand up, then sit down. Stand and sit are verbs. A verb tells you what someone does. Look at the first box on the board. It shows run, jump, eat, write and dance. Act one of them out.

draw.text: Verbs: words for doing and being

explain.say: Some verbs show no action. Look at the second box: am, is, are, was and were. These are being verbs. In I am six, the verb is am. Make a sentence with is.
Verbs can change their ending to tell you when. Look at the board. Jump with ing on the end makes jumping. It is happening now. I am jumping.
Now the ending is ed. The word is jumped. It already happened, in the past. Yesterday I jumped in a puddle. Change play to the past. You get played.
Look at the doing box again. A full sentence needs a verb. Find the verb in this sentence: Ana kicks the ball. The verb is kicks.

faq.a: A verb is a word for an action or a state of being, like run, eat, is or was. It tells you what happens in a sentence.
Yes. Is, am, are, was and were are forms of the verb be. They are being verbs, not action verbs.

faq.q: Does every sentence need a verb?
faq.a: Yes, a full sentence needs at least one verb. Without one, like The big red bus, it is only a phrase.
asks: Can a sentence have no verb?

faq.a: Verbs change their ending or add a helper word: I jump now, I jumped yesterday, I will jump tomorrow.
asks: How do verbs change for past?

faq.q: What is the shortest sentence in English?
faq.a: Go! is a full sentence. The person doing it, you, is understood, so the verb can stand alone.
asks: Can one word be a sentence?

facts: Go! is a complete English sentence: the subject you is understood.
Be is the most irregular English verb, with the forms am, is, are, was, were, been and being.

quiz.say: Read the sentence on the card. Which word is the verb?
quiz.show: Kofi sings in the choir. Which word is the verb?
quiz.why: sings tells you what Kofi does. So it is the verb.

wrong.0: Kofi is a noun. Kofi is the person doing the action.
wrong.2: choir is a noun. A choir is a group of singers.

quiz.say: Look at the 3 endings. Which ending shows something happened in the past?
quiz.why: jumped, played and wanted end in ed. They tell you it already happened.

wrong.0: ing shows it is happening now.
wrong.1: ly goes on describing words, like slowly and quickly.
